financial_years.quote: These Writ Petitions have been filed challenging the show cause notices dated 04.02.2025, issued by the first respondent for the Assessment Years 2018-2019 to 2024-2025.

date.quote: the first respondent proceeded to issue the impugned notices in Form DRC 01, dated 04.02.2025, for each of the tax periods involved from 2018-2025 (up to June 2024) across seven tax periods.
